candidates.titulo: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
candidates.resumen: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to create incentives for powerful AI models that make following the rules the most rational choice. candidates.resumen: Now in beta: Apple's new Audio Intelligence features can help you remember what someone said or take notes on conversations.

candidates.titulo: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
candidates.resumen:
Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware. candidates.titulo: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
candidates.resumen: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
